meta.title: FormSeva: Form Image Resizer & Compressor – Photo, Signature to KB
meta.description: FormSeva (Form Seva) is a free form image resizer and compressor. Resize photo and signature to 20 KB, 50 KB or any size, compress PDF and merge files. No upload.

site.footer: Runs entirely in your browser — your files never leave this device.

faq.a1: No. Everything happens in your browser on your own device, and location and camera details (EXIF) are removed from the resized file.
faq.q2: The form says 50 KB, but my file shows 48.8 KB. Why?
faq.a2: Some websites count 1 KB as 1000 bytes and others as 1024. We aim under the stricter reading, so the file passes on every portal.
faq.q3: My form asks for exact pixels or a minimum size.
faq.a3: Open Advanced to set a minimum size, an exact width × height, or PNG format. The quick presets are common limits; always check your form's own rules.

seo.aboutBody: FormSeva (Form Seva) is a free form image resizer and form image compressor for government job, exam and admission forms in India. Resize photos and signatures to the exact KB limit, compress PDFs, put Aadhaar or PAN on one A4 page and merge PDFs. Everything runs in your browser, so your files are never uploaded.

image.s1b: Drop a JPG or PNG, or tap to choose one from your phone or computer.
image.s2b: Type the maximum KB your form allows, or tap a common size.
image.s3b: It resizes instantly to just under your limit. Download it and upload it to your form.

pdf.s1b: Certificates, marksheets, scanned documents — any PDF.
pdf.s2b: Pick a quality, or enter the maximum size your form allows.
pdf.s3b: Get a smaller PDF that fits the limit, ready to upload.

idCard.s1b: Add a photo or scan of the front and back of your Aadhaar, PAN or other card.
idCard.s2b: Real size prints each side at 85.6 × 54 mm. Pick PDF, JPG or PNG.
idCard.s3b: Get one A4 page with both sides, ready to print or upload.

merge.s1b: Add PDFs and photos in any mix.
merge.s2b: Move files up or down. Turn on A4 to make every page the same size.
merge.s3b: Get one PDF with all your pages.

pdf.a1: Pages are saved as images to make them smaller, so text stays readable but can't be selected. Choose High quality if you need it sharper.
pdf.a2: No. The PDF is opened and compressed inside your browser, on your own device.
pdf.q3: What if my PDF is already small enough?
pdf.a3: If it is already under your limit, your original file is kept unchanged.

idCard.q1: Will it print at the real card size?
idCard.a1: Yes. With Real size selected, each side prints at 85.6 × 54 mm — the size of an Aadhaar or PAN card — on A4 paper.
idCard.q2: Which cards does it work with?
idCard.a2: Aadhaar, PAN, voter ID, driving licence, ration card or any other card of the standard size.
idCard.q3: Can I upload the result to a form?
idCard.a3: Yes. Choose PDF, JPG or PNG, and set a maximum size if the form has a limit.

merge.q1: Can I mix PDFs and photos?
merge.a1: Yes. Each photo becomes its own page, and with A4 turned on every page is fitted to A4 paper.
merge.q2: Is there a limit on files?
merge.a2: No fixed limit. Very large files depend on your device's memory, because everything happens in your browser.
merge.a3: No. Merging happens on your own device; nothing is sent anywhere.
